_about: NIST security categories per parameter set, transcribed from the standards themselves (not from product code) for test_algid.test_categories_match_fips_transcription. Second-agent check (O-9): requested in the PR that adds this file.

_sources.FIPS 203: FIPS 203 (August 13, 2024), Section 8, Table 2 'Approved parameter sets for ML-KEM': ML-KEM-512 category 1, ML-KEM-768 category 3, ML-KEM-1024 category 5
_sources.FIPS 204: FIPS 204 (August 13, 2024), Section 4, Table 1 'ML-DSA parameter sets': ML-DSA-44 category 2, ML-DSA-65 category 3, ML-DSA-87 category 5
_sources.FIPS 205: FIPS 205 (August 13, 2024), Section 11, Table 2 'SLH-DSA parameter sets': the -128s/-128f sets category 1, -192s/-192f category 3, -256s/-256f category 5, for both SHA2 and SHAKE
_sources.FIPS 206 ipd: FIPS 206 initial public draft (FN-DSA): FN-DSA-512 category 1, FN-DSA-1024 category 5
